The capability is consumed once and cannot be reconstructed by session JSON.

The loader locates selected Artifact files at the authenticated original cut, opens readonly retained descriptors and locates again. It then passes the real files and original trust to the original enrollment, which rechecks actual selected content, target, complete binding and consumer custody. A locator or descriptor DTO is not an authority substitute.

The CLI scopes the same-PID registration worker around the consuming original service. A successful worker flushes the original registration binding immediately after all real register/postchecks, while the service is running. The RAII stop guard executes before joins even on service errors; the main path propagates served? after joining. It does not print a successful registration before completion or create a second Root writer.
